headerDisplay: Optimises Tesla EV charging against live Sense Solar data. Turn the HomeKit switch ON to start — the plugin will set charging amps to match available solar surplus.
footerDisplay: For help and documentation visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/irajczi/homebridge-sense-tesla-ev-optimization).

teslaEmail.title: Tesla Account Email
teslaEmail.description: Optional — used for display purposes only.

teslaRefreshToken.title: Refresh Token
teslaRefreshToken.description: Required for Owner's API. Obtain via the tesla_auth app or similar tool.

fleetClientId.title: Fleet API Client ID
fleetClientId.description: Required for Fleet API. The UUID of your registered Tesla application.

fleetApiKey.title: Fleet API Client Secret
fleetApiKey.description: Required for Fleet API. The client secret of your registered Tesla application.

vehicleVIN.title: Vehicle VIN
vehicleVIN.description: Optional — if omitted, the first vehicle on the account is used.

minimumChargeAmps.title: Minimum Charge Amps
minimumChargeAmps.description: Charging will not start (or will stop) below this current.

maximumChargeAmps.title: Maximum Charge Amps
maximumChargeAmps.description: Charging will never exceed this current, even with surplus solar.

pollingIntervalSeconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingIntervalSeconds.description: How often to read Sense data and recalculate charging amps.

stopWhenInsufficient.title: Stop Charging When Solar Is Insufficient
stopWhenInsufficient.description: When enabled, charging stops if solar surplus drops below the minimum amps. When disabled, charging continues at the minimum.

adaptivePollingEnabled.title: Enable Adaptive Polling
adaptivePollingEnabled.description: Reduce API usage by backing off to slower checks when solar and home readings are stable.

adaptiveStableAfterMinutes.title: Stable After (minutes)
adaptiveStableAfterMinutes.description: How long readings must stay stable before backing off to the slower interval.

adaptiveStableIntervalSeconds.title: Stable Polling Interval (seconds)
adaptiveStableIntervalSeconds.description: Polling interval used after readings are stable. 300 seconds is 5 minutes.

adaptiveChangeThresholdWatts.title: Change Threshold (watts)
adaptiveChangeThresholdWatts.description: Solar or home watt changes above this amount return polling to the normal interval.

autoOffAfterNoSolarMinutes.title: Auto-off After No Solar (minutes)
autoOffAfterNoSolarMinutes.description: Flip the HomeKit switch OFF automatically once solar production has been zero for this many minutes. Leave blank to disable.

dailyWakeEnabled.title: Enable Location-aware Daily Wake
dailyWakeEnabled.description: When enabled, the switch can stay on while the plugin waits until sunrise plus the configured offset, then wakes the car only if it is home and plugged in.

homeAddress.title: Home Address
homeAddress.description: Optional. If coordinates are blank, this address is looked up with OpenStreetMap Nominatim from your Homebridge host at startup.

homeLatitude.title: Home Latitude
homeLatitude.description: Optional when Home Address is provided; required for daily wake if you do not want address lookup.

homeLongitude.title: Home Longitude
homeLongitude.description: Optional when Home Address is provided; required for daily wake if you do not want address lookup.

homeTimezone.title: Home Timezone
homeTimezone.description: IANA timezone used for sunrise scheduling. If blank, the plugin suggests one from the address lookup.

homeRadiusMeters.title: At-home Radius (meters)
homeRadiusMeters.description: The car must be within this radius of home to start the daily solar check.

wakeAfterSunriseMinutes.title: Wake After Sunrise (minutes)
wakeAfterSunriseMinutes.description: How many minutes after local sunrise to wake the car and check whether it is home, plugged in, and not full.

sleepAfterInsufficientMinutes.title: Sleep After Low Solar (minutes)
sleepAfterInsufficientMinutes.description: If solar surplus stays below the minimum amps this long, stop trying until the next morning. Leave blank to keep checking all day.

powerExpensiveStartTime.title: Power Expensive Start Time
powerExpensiveStartTime.description: Optional advanced setting. At this local time, charging stops so solar can export to the grid. Use 24-hour HH:MM; blank disables.
